falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 low invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug required that level to hold as support, and its failure indicates continuation of the downtrend rather than a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility spike exceeding the August 2024 peak (VIX 32.5) demonstrates panic escalation rather than stabilization; the blowoff score of 40 implies controlled de-risking, and uncontrolled volatility expansion confirms this is not a bottoming process but an accelerating liquidation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 3.80% and holds there for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained flight-to-quality bid into Treasuries with yields collapsing through the August 2024 low indicates systemic stress/credit event rather than growth-scare bottom; the pattern match requires yields to stabilize in a range (4.00-4.40%) to confirm economic soft-landing narrative, and sub-3.80% signals recession pricing that breaks the bottom structure
